_about: Whose number a card's phone is, when it is not the food bank's own (church, parent charity). build.py copies a non-empty string onto 'phone_label' (blank ignored). The list card and the pin pop-up show it under the number, as written if it ends in 'number' or 'line' (e.g. 'St X church number', 'Referral line', 'Library service line', 'Central service line', 'Shared venue line'), otherwise as 'Number for <label>'. Shelters and warm spaces use the same wording from an optional phone_label on their contact override. Dean 24 Oct.
